summary.zh: 从提交记录生成发布说明，并推荐下一个版本号
summary.en: Turn commits into release notes and pick the next semver version.

description.zh: 汇总两次发布之间的提交，分类整理成 CHANGELOG 和面向用户的发布说明，并按语义化版本推荐下一个版本号。适合准备发版、写更新公告，或先梳理提交信息规范的时候。
description.en: Collects the commits between releases, groups them into a CHANGELOG and user-facing notes, and suggests the next semantic version. Use it when cutting a release, announcing changes or tidying commit messages first.
